name: use-session-storage
title: useSessionStorage
description: Represents the options for customizing the behavior of serialization and deserialization.

tags.template: - The type of the state to be stored in session storage.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: - The key under which the value will be stored in session storage.

parameters.name: initialValue
parameters.description: - The initial value of the state or a function that returns the initial value.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: - Options for customizing the behavior of serialization and deserialization (optional).

properties.name: serializer
properties.description: A function to serialize the value before storing it.

properties.name: deserializer
properties.description: A function to deserialize the stored value.

properties.name: initializeWithValue
properties.description: If `true` (default), the hook will initialize reading the session storage. In SSR, you should set it to `false`, returning the initial value initially.

returnType.name: [T, Dispatch<SetStateAction<T>>, () => void]
returnType.description: A tuple containing the stored value, a function to set the value and a function to remove the key from storage.
